windows.notes: QuickPrompts: type a trigger and Space in any app to paste a saved prompt, or press Ctrl+Alt+Space to pick one.

macos.notes: QuickPrompts: type a trigger and Space in any app to paste a saved prompt, or press ⌃⌥P to pick one. The video editor gets the clip bin, picture in picture and split screen, flip, loop, guides, speed per clip and Reverse; scrub videos in the gallery.
